request.query: If integers u_i have gcd 1 and all u_i * v are integers, then the rational v is an integer

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Tactic.NormNum.isInt_ratNum",
      "informal_name": "Numerator of Reduced Rational Number",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {q : ℚ} {n : ℤ} {n' d : ℕ},\n  Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsRat q n d → n.natAbs = n' → n'.gcd d = 1 → Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt q.num n",
      "informal_description": "If a rational number $ q $ is represented as $ \\frac{n}{d} $ with $ n' = |n| $, $ d \\in \\mathbb{N} $, and $ \\gcd(n', d) = 1 $, then the numerator of $ q $ is equal to the integer $ n $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum.GCD"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsRat.to_isInt",
      "informal_name": "Rational to Integer Conversion in Rings with Denominator One",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Ring α] {a : α} {n : ℤ}, Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsRat a n 1 → Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt a n",
      "informal_description": "For any ring $\\alpha$ and element $a \\in \\alpha$, if $a$ is equal to the rational number $\\frac{n}{1}$ (i.e., $\\mathrm{IsRat}(a, n, 1)$), then $a$ is equal to the integer $n$ (i.e., $\\mathrm{IsInt}(a, n)$).",
      "path": "Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum.Result"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Tactic.NormNum.isInt_isCoprime",
      "informal_name": "Coprime Integers Imply Coprimality in Integer Ring",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y nx ny : ℤ}, Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt x nx → Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt y ny → IsCoprime nx ny → IsCoprime x y",
      "informal_description": "If two integers $ nx $ and $ ny $ are coprime, then their corresponding elements $ x $ and $ y $ in the ring of integers are also coprime.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum.IsCoprime"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "EisensteinSeries.gammaSet_eq_gcd_mul_divIntMap",
      "informal_name": "Gamma Set Element Decomposition as GCD Multiple",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {r : ℕ} {v : Fin 2 → ℤ}, v ∈ EisensteinSeries.gammaSet 1 r 0 → v = r • EisensteinSeries.divIntMap (↑r) v",
      "informal_description": "For any integer vector $ v = (x, y) $ with $ \\gcd(x, y) = r $, it holds that $ v = r \\cdot \\left( \\frac{x}{r}, \\frac{y}{r} \\right) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.NumberTheory.ModularForms.EisensteinSeries.Defs"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Tactic.NormNum.isInt_not_isCoprime",
      "informal_name": "Non-Coprime Integers Imply Non-Coprime Elements in the Ring",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {x y nx ny : ℤ}, Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt x nx → Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt y ny → ¬IsCoprime nx ny → ¬IsCoprime x y",
      "informal_description": "If two integers $n$ and $m$ are not coprime, then their canonical embeddings $x = n$ and $y = m$ into any ring are also not coprime as elements of that ring.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum.IsCoprime"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Rat.div_int_inj",
      "informal_name": "Injectivity of Reduced Integer Division in Rationals",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {a b c d : ℤ},\n  0 < b → 0 < d → a.natAbs.Coprime b.natAbs → c.natAbs.Coprime d.natAbs → ↑a / ↑b = ↑c / ↑d → a = c ∧ b = d",
      "informal_description": "For integers $a,b,c,d$ with $b>0$, $d>0$, and $\\gcd(|a|,|b|)=\\gcd(|c|,|d|)=1$, if $\\frac{a}{b} = \\frac{c}{d}$ in $\\mathbb{Q}$, then $a=c$ and $b=d$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Rat.Lemmas"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Rat.num_den_mk",
      "informal_name": "Rational Number Numerator-Denominator Factorization",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {q : ℚ} {n d : ℤ}, d ≠ 0 → q = Rat.divInt n d → ∃ c, n = c * q.num ∧ d = c * ↑q.den",
      "informal_description": "For any rational number $q$ and integers $n, d$ with $d \\neq 0$ such that $q = \\frac{n}{d}$, there exists an integer $c$ such that $n = c \\cdot \\text{num}(q)$ and $d = c \\cdot \\text{den}(q)$, where $\\text{num}(q)$ and $\\text{den}(q)$ denote the numerator and denominator of $q$ in reduced form.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Rat.Lemmas"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Rat.exists_eq_mul_div_num_and_eq_mul_div_den",
      "informal_name": "Existence of a Common Integer Factor for Rational Number Representation",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n : ℤ) {d : ℤ}, d ≠ 0 → ∃ c, n = c * (↑n / ↑d).num ∧ d = c * ↑(↑n / ↑d).den",
      "informal_description": "For any integers $n$ and $d$ with $d \\neq 0$, there exists an integer $c$ such that $n = c \\cdot \\text{num}(n/d)$ and $d = c \\cdot \\text{den}(n/d)$, where $\\text{num}(n/d)$ and $\\text{den}(n/d)$ denote the numerator and denominator of the rational number $n/d$ in its reduced form.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Rat.Lemmas"
    }
  ]
}
